title: Defence boost: Govt clears mega Rs 2.12 lakh crore acquisition deal; who gets what
content: On October 26, the Defence Acquisition Council has given the green light for a substantial military funding initiative totaling Rs 2.12 lakh crore. The focus lies on enhancing the capabilities of the Indian Army, Navy, and Air Force. Notably, about 82 percent of these procurements are anticipated to be sourced from domestic producers, thereby fostering local manufacturing.

title: 'Stand near a powerful fan': India coach's unique advice to players ahead of Test
content: India will play a two-match Test series against New Zealand after the ongoing T20I and ODI series. The first Test is scheduled to begin at the Basin Reserve in Wellington on November 18.

title: Bill Gates says Meta’s Muse is the first great consumer AI product, but has one worry
content: Microsoft co-founder Bill Gates has called Meta's Muse "the first truly great consumer AI product" in an interview with The Verge, revealing he congratulated chief AI officer Alexandr Wang on the personal AI agent. Gates said Muse stands out because it actually gets tasks done, but warned that open-weight AI models with removable safeguards are irresponsible, a week after Meta released its own Muse Spark Open.

title: 'Rising runoff, flood risks': Fresh warning over China’s mega Brahmaputra dam
content: Chinese researchers highlight potential increases in runoff and flood risks for the Brahmaputra River this century. Their study uses tree-ring data to model future climate scenarios affecting runoff. The implications of the $168 billion mega dam project in Tibet raise concerns for downstream countries like India and Bangladesh. Researchers urge careful planning of water-resource infrastructure to mitigate risks associated with international river management.

title: Judge orders halt to Trump voter probes in 9 states, stays ruling for appeal
content: v A federal judge in California issued a temporary halt on federal investigations into suspected noncitizen voter registration. This ruling follows concerns regarding the reliance on flawed data by federal agents during their investigations. Judge Araceli Martínez-Olguín stated that the investigations risked intimidating eligible voters ahead of the elections. The case was brought forward by several civic organizations advocating for voter rights.

title: From Amazon to Google: The tech giants betting billions on Anthropic’s IPO
content: Anthropic is gearing up for its IPO, aiming to go public on the Nasdaq. With significant investments from tech giants Amazon and Google, totaling billions, the company has ambitious plans to boost its AI infrastructure and enhance safety research. Over the next decade, Anthropic intends to engage in substantial financial commitments with six strategic partners, showcasing the pivotal role of leading tech companies in its growth trajectory.

title: 82-foot whale made from 5,000lb of plastic named Roadside America sight of week
content: Ethyl the Whale, an impressive 82-foot sculpture, currently resides at Santa Fe Community College in New Mexico. Designed by artists Joel Dean Stockdill and Yustina Salnikova, this monumental piece is crafted from approximately 5,000 pounds of discarded plastic. It draws attention to the crisis of ocean pollution and showcases how art can be born from trash, serving as a vital monument for sustainability and environmental awareness.

title: Why used cars just below round mileage figures fetch up to $168 more
content: A recent study showed that used car dealers profit from mileage readings just under round-number thresholds. The researchers analyzed millions of transactions to determine pricing impacts of left-digit bias. Buyers often overlook minor differences in mileage, focusing instead on the first digit. This inattention allows dealers to charge more for cars that appear to be better value.

title: State that Musk urges companies to move halts 17 data center permits: Here’s the reason
content: Texas has suspended permits for 17 data center projects as automated approvals continued despite a freeze. Governor Greg Abbott mandated the halt on new data center approvals due to environmental concerns. An automated licensing software malfunction contributed to unauthorized approvals slipping through. State regulators have intervened to ensure all applications are manually reviewed moving forward. A comprehensive audit of existing data centers is underway to assess their impact on resources.

title: Lawmaker seeks nearly 200 withheld texts in fight over Trump's Kennedy Center
content: A Democratic US lawmaker has asked a federal judge to order the Trump administration to release nearly 200 withheld text messages concerning Washington's Kennedy Center. The request comes amid a legal dispute over plans to close the performing arts centre for renovations, months after a judge ruled that Trump's name had been illegally added to the building and ordered its removal.

title: Massachusetts gun owners face Oct 28 registration deadline before repeal vote
content: Gun legislation is making headlines as the U.S. elections approach, with Massachusetts taking a strict stance while Idaho opts for a more symbolic gesture. Massachusetts enforces a deadline for firearm registration as it nears the polls, raising concerns about the legal ramifications for compliant gun owners. In stark contrast, Idaho's ballot proposal to designate an official state firearm serves as a tribute to its hunting heritage without direct legal consequences.

title: Scarlett Johansson and Colin Jost bought $27.5m-listed NYC penthouse for $13m
content: Scarlett Johansson and Colin Jost have purchased a co-op penthouse in Manhattan, which took seven years to sell. The property was initially listed at $27.5 million and underwent several price reductions before the sale. It spans 6,000 square feet and features numerous luxurious amenities, including six bedrooms and seven bathrooms. The previous owners had made extensive renovations before selling, which likely facilitated the eventual sale.

title: Tyreek Hill’s Chiefs reunion hopes hit setback as Kansas City weighs injury risks
content: Tyreek Hill’s potential return to the Kansas City Chiefs has lost momentum as concerns over his recovery from a serious knee injury continue. The 32-year-old wide receiver suffered multiple ligament tears in 2025 and underwent two surgeries. Coach Andy Reid indicated that “nothing is happening” regarding a reunion. With Patrick Mahomes performing well alongside Xavier Worthy and Travis Kelce, Kansas City appears content to avoid the medical risks of signing Hill.

title: Travis Kelce’s $5.35 million estate faces new setback as neighbors object
content: Travis Kelce’s $5.35 million Ohio mansion faces fresh delays as neighbors challenge his landscaping and fencing plans. Residents have raised concerns about wildlife safety, lake views and potential damage to an aging sewer line, with one neighbor citing $75,000 in repair costs. Kelce’s construction team says it has spent $7,500 on sewer repairs and adjusted the plans. However, local officials require further changes before the remaining landscaping work can proceed.

title: Defence minister shares vision on Phase 2 of Atmanirbharta
content: Defence minister Rajnath Singh has signaled a significant shift towards enhanced self-reliance in India's defence sector. This transformative phase aims to weave advanced technologies into military capabilities. Navy chief Admiral Krishna Swaminathan underlines the urgency for rapid innovation to boost operational efficiency, while Vice Admiral Ajay Kochhar highlights how the ongoing Ukraine conflict exemplifies the fast-evolving nature of warfare driven by tech advancements.

title: As Kohli, Rohit's era winds down, Klusener sees Sooryavanshi as 'next superstar'
content: Lance Klusener is optimistic about the future of Indian cricket, emphasizing that the legacy will endure even after legends like Virat Kohli and Rohit Sharma step back. He sees Shubman Gill as a viable leader for the future and also points to Vaibhav Sooryavanshi, stating that his rising talent signals the next wave of cricketing excellence. With each new generation, the sport continues to evolve.

title: 'Party funds' for DMK? Ex-Tamil Nadu minister held in Rs 100 crore 'school scam' case
content: A CCB team reached his apartment in Aminjikarai and arrested him after Madras high court dismissed his anticipatory bail application.

title: Meet Siddharth Vikram: Brother's accident inspired $25,000-winning app idea
content: Siddharth Vikram has crafted ReHappy, a groundbreaking app that turns the monotony of physical therapy into exciting game-based challenges for young patients. Inspired by his brother's recovery journey, Siddharth's initiative aims to make rehabilitation fun and engaging. Earning a $25,000 prize in a national competition has propelled his vision forward, and he is now seeking technical guidance to refine the app's clinical application and features for youth rehabilitation.

title: San Francisco mansion listed at $18.5m sells for $28.5m just 20 days later
content: An eight-bedroom mansion in San Francisco sold for $28.5 million, which was $10 million above the asking price. The sale occurred after the property had been on the market for only 20 days. Built in 1966, the house features a large lot and views of the Presidio, making it unique. This sale marks the end of 40 years of ownership by the Lurie family.

title: Dylan Larkin trade rumors: Why could a Red Wings deal be closer than expected?
content: Dylan Larkin's trade prospects are generating buzz among NHL teams, sparking recent conversations. The Detroit Red Wings are on the lookout for young centers, while Larkin has broadened his list of acceptable teams. Although analysts predict a trading window by late October, no transactions have been finalized. The team's high asking price could complicate negotiations, but Larkin's cooperation and a beneficial return for Detroit are pivotal for any trade.

title: Bhopal Metro burns Rs 50 lakh in a week, takes over 100 days to earn it back
content: Bhopal Metro incurs nearly Rs 50 lakh in operational costs weekly, with ticket sales lagging far behind. The estimated daily ridership is between 150 to 500 commuters, which does not meet financial needs. Ticket earnings are insufficient, reflecting challenges in attracting more passengers to the service. Initiatives to generate additional revenue through advertising and events have not yet proven effective.

title: Russia’s 70-year-old Bear: The Tu-95 bomber that still patrols near America’s doorstep
content: Russia's Cold War-era Tu-95MS strategic bombers have embarked on a scheduled patrol near Alaska, emphasizing the aircraft's lasting significance in long-range military operations. Designed for launching long-range cruise missiles, these bombers enable Russia to target areas while avoiding heavily defended airspace. Their continued deployment illustrates Russia's effectiveness in executing strategic missions over extensive distances and highlights its enduring long-range strike capabilities.

title: BJP launches protests across India over Kharge's 'baap' remark, demands apology
content: In response to Mallikarjun Kharge's recent remarks about Prime Minister Narendra Modi, BJP activists took to the streets in various locations including Bihar, Jammu, and Bengaluru. The protests, spearheaded by local BJP leaders, called for an official apology from Kharge. While Congress rallied behind Kharge, the BJP accused him of demonstrating a lack of respect towards Modi and his family, igniting a national debate on political respect and decorum.

title: Surat doctor brings eye care to villages, performs over 30,000 free surgeries
content: Dr. Bhavin Patel's innovative outreach initiative focuses on delivering essential eye care to the underserved villages of Gujarat. The program encompasses routine eye screenings, surgical interventions, and rehabilitation services for the visually impaired. By addressing significant accessibility issues, it notably improves health outcomes and decreases preventable blindness rates. Community volunteers actively assist in organizing screenings and guiding patients to specialized facilities, emphasizing the critical need for localized healthcare services.

title: Ballon d'Or: Messi, Yamal and Mbappe among favourites; how the winners are decided
content: At 39, Messi still remains in contention for football's biggest individual honour after his performances at the World Cup. While the focus is increasingly shifting towards a potential Yamal-Mbappé rivalry, Harry Kane's remarkable goalscoring form could delay the start of a new era by another year.

title: 'We can make the final again': Markram outlines South Africa’s WTC ambition
content: Aiden Markram is optimistic about South Africa's chances of reaching the ICC World Test Championship final again. They recently equalized the series against Australia with a solid performance in Gqeberha. As the pivotal third Test approaches at Newlands, both sides aim for dominance, although South Africa will be without fast bowler Anrich Nortje due to an injury. Meanwhile, Australia plans to adjust its batting lineup following their recent struggles.

title: Delhi’s war on dust: Why city’s pollution hotspots remain a challenge
content: Delhi grapple with ongoing air pollution issues, largely attributed to insufficient dust management and the build-up of road dust. While efforts like mechanical sweepers and anti-smog guns are put in place, several roads are left in disrepair. Furthermore, construction sites add to the dilemma with inadequately covered materials and unlawful dumping.

title: 25 Arizona voters wrongly flagged as noncitizens regain access before midterms
content: Twenty-five US citizens in Arizona have regained their voting access after being wrongly flagged as possible noncitizens. Their registrations were restored following court-ordered mediation between Maricopa County Recorder Justin Heap and Attorney General Kris Mayes on October 23. The agreement ended a lawsuit over the restrictions, allowing the affected citizens to vote in the November 3 midterm elections.

title: Rally v rally: INDIA bloc plans mega show in Delhi; Shah to lead padayatra in T'gana
content: Congress party president Mallikarjun Kharge announced a rally in New Delhi to protest vote theft allegations. The rally, titled 'Vote Bachao, Desh Bachao,' aims to challenge the special electoral roll revision process. Meanwhile, BJP leader Amit Shah will participate in a counter-march in Telangana on November 2. The political tension arises from differing accusations regarding electoral irregularities and vote deletions.

title: Andy Reid takes responsibility after Chiefs’ 20-3 loss to Seahawks
content: After the Kansas City Chiefs' disappointing 3-20 loss to the Seattle Seahawks, head coach Andy Reid expressed his accountability for the game’s outcome. Patrick Mahomes had a tough night, tallying only 165 passing yards and no touchdowns. The Chiefs' offense managed just 213 yards, while Seattle dominated third downs. With their next matchup against the Denver Broncos ahead, the Chiefs must address their shortcomings to turn their season around.

title: Three strangers find Irishman's lost wedding ring in Italy, fly to return it
content: During a delightful family vacation in Italy, an Irish father accidentally lost his wedding ring while enjoying time with his kids. Determined to recover it, his wife enlisted the help of three local good Samaritans who tirelessly searched the river for three days. Miraculously, they located the ring and even journeyed to Ireland to return it personally, forging unexpected bonds between the Irish family and their Italian rescuers.

title: Asin's daughter, 8, can speak 12 languages, says dad; no TV or phones at home
content: Asin Thottumkal and Rahul Sharma deliberately choose to raise their daughter Arin in a tech-free environment, opting for books over screens. By fostering a love for reading, they encourage a deep learning experience. At only eight years old, Arin impressively communicates in 12 languages, highlighting her parents' commitment to her education.

title: Ghost of Yom Kippur War returns as Israel drills for surprise attack amid Iran tensions
content: Israel has begun a significant 48-hour military exercise to enhance readiness against potential surprise attacks. The exercise involves multiple military divisions, including air force units, preparing for threats across various fronts. IDF Chief of Staff Eyal Zamir highlighted concerns regarding increased risk due to regional tensions. These drills come shortly before the national election, adding to security concerns. Military planners aim to learn from past conflicts to improve response strategies.

title: Govt allows E100 fuel for select cars, bars E20 vehicles from using it
content: The government has amended the Central Motor Vehicles Rules to facilitate the registration of flex-fuel vehicles capable of running on 85% to 100% ethanol blended petrol. As car manufacturers gear up to introduce their E100 models soon, this initiative promises to lessen emissions and curb reliance on crude oil imports. Notably, existing vehicle owners are not required to make any modifications.

title: Zepto charged Rs 34 above MRP; consumer court ordered them to pay Rs 57,000
content: District Consumer Disputes Redressal Commission found Zepto charged more than the maximum retail price for groceries. Advocate K Shiva Ganesh filed a complaint regarding inflated prices on Zepto's platform. The commission determined that this practice was misleading and constituted unfair trade. Zepto was directed to compensate the complainant and deposit funds into the legal aid account. The company was also instructed to discontinue such practices in the future.

title: Over 10 lakh NCR vehicles won't be able to enter Delhi from November 1
content: Delhi plans to prohibit entry of vehicles not meeting BS6 emission standards in NCR from November 2026. Over 10 lakh vehicles in Gurgaon, Faridabad, Noida, Greater Noida, and Ghaziabad may be affected. Gurgaon and Faridabad hold around 2 lakh vehicles below BS6 standards, mostly consisting of BS3 and BS4 categories. Additionally, approximately 50,000 commercial vehicles in both locations do not comply with the new regulations.
